claims: Blockchain technology is a decentralized digital ledger.
Blockchain technology is a distributed digital ledger.
Blockchain technology is an immutable digital ledger.
Blockchain technology is used to record transactions across a network of computers.
Blockchain technology uses consensus mechanisms to validate data.
Blockchain data is stored in blocks.
Blocks are linked in chronological chains.
The blockchain ledger is shared among a peer-to-peer (P2P) network.
The blockchain ledger does not use a central server.
Transactions are recorded into blocks in blockchain.
Assets are recorded into blocks in blockchain.
Nodes in the blockchain network are computers.
Nodes in the blockchain network use consensus algorithms to verify new blocks.
Proof of Work is a consensus algorithm.
Validated blocks are connected to the previous block using cryptography.
The blockchain ledger is nearly impossible to alter.
Blockchain reduces transaction times from days to minutes.
Bitcoin is a cryptocurrency.
Ethereum is a cryptocurrency.
Blockchain is used in supply chain management to track the movement of goods.
Smart contracts are self-executing contracts.
Terms of smart contracts are directly written into code.
Blockchain is used for digital IDs to secure personal information.
Blockchain is used for voting to ensure voting integrity.
Certain consensus mechanisms used in blockchain have high energy consumption.
Blockchain technology has scalability issues.
Blockchain technology faces regulatory uncertainty.
